critical_boundaries: Hard voltage interval is a declared premise, not Gaussian sigma or an empirically validated cell guarantee. No truth in inference/config centering/starts/corrections.
Capacity bins remain fixed; retained SOC0 strips carry finite outer constraints. Nonempty support may contain false positives. No Gaussian likelihood equivalence or multiplicity preservation.
An all-zero-charge prefix cannot distinguish capacity. Returning to zero after informative history retains exclusions. Current SOC width may grow during charge while history contracts.
Negative errors leave the complete bank unchanged and do not propagate the sample. Valid contradiction advances physical state and commits sticky empty support. Recovery is not implicit.
Generic API capacity domain is the union of bins; gaps are not feasible just because the query returns a hull. Availability corollary has the stated capacity upper bound.
Live immutable config, disjoint storage, ordered admitted input and no concurrent mutation/hardware fault are premises. Delivery, persistence, uncertaincurrent and drift need explicit proofs.
No silent forgetting, reset error ledger, double counting, unbounded external counter or finite-endurance substitute.
